name: agy-bridge
description: Delegate coding work to Google Antigravity (Gemini) from Claude.
long_description: Exposes the Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as MCP tools so Claude can hand test-writing, boilerplate and other mechanical coding work to Gemini and get back a digest plus a git diff instead of a wall of output. Also exposes agy slash commands and arbitrary flags. Every run is forced onto the signed-in Google account: metered API-key and Vertex credentials are stripped from the child environment before agy starts.

wsl_distro.title: WSL distro
wsl_distro.description: Name of the WSL distro where agy is installed and logged in, e.g. Ubuntu. Check with `wsl -l -q`. Leave EMPTY on macOS/Linux, or if agy is installed natively on Windows.

allowed_roots.title: Allowed write roots
allowed_roots.description: Colon-separated directories Gemini may write in. Use paths as the machine running agy sees them — with a WSL distro set, that means WSL paths like /mnt/c/Users/you/Documents/GitHub. Nothing outside these runs in write mode.

default_model.title: Default model slug
default_model.description: Model used when a call does not pin one. Must appear in `agy models` or Antigravity will silently substitute another.

max_chars.title: Digest size (characters)
max_chars.description: How much of Gemini's response is kept in Claude's context. The full transcript always goes to a file on disk.

agy_bin.title: agy binary
agy_bin.description: Path to the agy executable. Leave as `agy` unless it is not on PATH.

tools.name: delegate
tools.description: Run a coding task on a Gemini model via agy; supports plan mode; returns a digest plus the git diffstat

tools.name: command
tools.description: Run an agy slash command such as /usage, /plan or /teamwork-preview

tools.name: help
tools.description: Discover this agy install's flags and slash commands

tools.name: models
tools.description: List the model slugs this agy install can reach

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Check the agy binary, auth path and bridge configuration
